correctness.rationale: The source multiplication table for DT_3^1 and its derivation definition were reconstructed directly. Writing a general linear map and imposing the Leibniz rule for each of the three products yields exactly \(\begin{pmatrix}a&0&0\\b&2a&c\\0&0&a\end{pmatrix}\). An exact checker verifies all seven tridendriform identities on the printed table, constructs every derivation constraint, obtains rank six in nine variables, and checks the three displayed basis derivations and their Lie brackets.

value.rationale: Corollary 4.2 is a headline structural conclusion of a low-dimensional classification paper, and it is used to summarize the entire three-dimensional derivation theory. A complete derivation algebra for the first listed model is therefore a substantive correction rather than a cosmetic typo. The result not only exhibits one counterexample but gives the full three-dimensional derivation Lie algebra and its semidirect-product structure, which is immediately reusable in deformation and symmetry calculations.
